messages.text: Sunday, September 27 · Canton, Michigan
Overcast skies, full moon, and jazz echoes
A mild, overcast Sunday offers a mix of local arts and music events, alongside a significant urban development story from Ann Arbor. The moon is full, a bright presence in the autumn sky.
Today will be overcast with a high near 75°F and a low around 49°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:27 AM and sunset is at 7:22 PM, with the full moon 99.5% illuminated.
Sunday's nearby sounds and sights

In Ann Arbor, catch the Jazz Fest at The Ravens Club starting at 2 PM, or experience the Women in Jazz Showcase at Blue LLaMA Jazz Club at 6 PM. For an artistic reception, visit Kerrytown Concert House for Esther Kirshenbaum's 'A Symphony of Seeing' at 4 PM.
My Birthday is coming up on September 30.
Ann Arbor plans for downtown sale proceeds

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the expected $14.2 million to $17.4 million from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated across 12 distinct projects.
Tomorrow and beyond

Tomorrow, consider the Ypsi Farmers & Gardeners Oral History Exhibit at YDL-Superior or the 'FALL GARDENING CHORES' session at YDL-Whittaker at 2 PM. On September 28, Willi Carlisle performs at The Ark in Ann Arbor at 8 PM.
Satellites navigate without GPS; telescopes prepare for launch

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has completed its flight-readiness review and is proceeding toward final launch preparations.
The Starship schedule is unset, with no official launch date listed.
May your day unfold with quiet discoveries.
Monday, September 28 · Canton, Michigan
Full Moon Rises Over Partly Cloudy Skies
Partly cloudy skies welcome a warm autumn day with a high near 76°F. Tonight, the full moon will rise, offering a bright presence in the evening sky.
Today will be partly cloudy with a high near 76°F and a low around 49°F, with a 1% chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:28 AM and sunset is at 7:20 PM, with the full moon rising around 8:02 PM, 96.9% illuminated.
Local and Nearby Events

For a local evening, consider the "FALL GARDENING CHORES" workshop at YDL-Whittaker at 2:00 PM. Later, the "Ypsi Farmers & Gardeners Oral History Exhibit" is free at YDL-Superior, and Detroit offers "Drumming on the Riverfront" at 6:00 PM.
Later this week, My Birthday and Patrick's Birthday fall on September 30.
University of Michigan Advances Cancer Treatment Research

The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to advance non-invasive cancer treatments using soundwaves. This technique, already FDA-approved for liver tumors, uses targeted soundwaves to break apart tumors without surgical interve…
Tomorrow and Beyond
Tomorrow, explore "AI for the Everyday: An Interactive Workshop" at Farmington Library at 6:00 PM, or attend "Coffee & Conversation with AICPA Chair Jan Lewis" at Schoolcraft College at 10:00 AM.
Satellites Navigate Without GPS, Roman Telescope Readies for Launch

NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and a catalog of space objects. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has also cleared its flight-readiness review, targeting a launch later this month.
The next Starship launch estimate is no earlier than September 18, 2026, though this is an independent estimate and not an official SpaceX schedule.
May the quiet hours bring a sense of discovery.
